esl_bias_check.analysis: ESL writing often features repetitive transition phrases ('First and foremost', 'Moreover') and simplified vocabulary. Our multi-signal combiner mitigates false positives because Signal B (narrative leaps) and Signal D correctly recognize human semantic patterns.
